text: The satellites checked for fire detections on this asset were VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21, and MODIS. These satellites are part of the NASA FIRMS dataset used to monitor active fire and thermal anomalies. The data covers the period from October 4, 2026, to November 3, 2026, and includes detections where the fire footprint intersects the asset.
